events.name: Oakland Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Tyreek Hill had touchdowns receiving and on a punt return, Kansas City's defense made life miserable for Oakland quarterback Derek Carr, and the Chiefs beat the Raiders 21-13 on a frigid Thursday
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs hold off Raiders 21-13 to take control of AFC West

headlines.description: Le'Veon Bell scored three times and set a franchise record with 236 yards rushing on a slick, snow-covered field, leading the Pittsburgh Steelers to a 27-20 win over the Buffalo Bills.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bell tolls 3 times for Steelers in 27-20 over Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Robert Griffin III returned from injury but couldn't keep Cleveland from falling closer to infamy as the Cincinnati Bengals built a big early lead and held off the winless Browns 23-10 on Sunday
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns fall to 0-13, lose 23-10 to Bengals

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford ran for a 7-yard touchdown with 3:17 left after throwing two interceptions in the fourth quarter -- including a pick-six -- as the Lions held on to beat the Bears 20-17 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford runs for go-ahead TD in Lions' 20-17 win over Bears

headlines.description: DeMarco Murray ran for 92 yards and a touchdown, and the Tennessee Titans held on to beat the Denver Broncos 13-10 Sunday and keep a piece of first place in the AFC South.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray, Titans run to early lead, hold off Broncos 13-10

headlines.description: Lamar Miller scored Houston's only touchdown and the Texans defense stopped Andrew Luck on Indy's final drive of the game to preserve a 22-17 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans take key AFC South matchup with 22-17 win over Colts

headlines.description: Ryan Tannehill threw three TDs before being sidelined with a knee injury, and Andrew Franks kicked a 21-yard field goal as time expired to help the Miami Dolphins beat the Arizona Cardinals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tannehill hurt as Dolphins beat Cards on late kick, 26-23

headlines.description: Chris Thompson's 25-yard touchdown run with 1:54 remaining lifted the Washington Redskins to a 27-22 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday.

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Carolina's defense forced five turnovers by Philip Rivers, recorded five sacks and a safety, and the Panthers defeated the San Diego Chargers 28-16 on Sunday.
Matt Asiata scored on a short TD run, Kai Forbath kicked four field goals and the Minnesota Vikings beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 25-16 on Sunday, winning for just the second time in nine weeks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings beat Jaguars 25-16 for 1st road win since September

events.name: New York Jets at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Bilal Powell ran for 145 yards, including the game-ending 19-yard touchdown in overtime, to help Bryce Petty and the New York Jets rally from 14 points down to beat the San Francisco 49ers 23-17.
headlines.shortLinkText: Powell, Petty rally Jets past 49ers 23-17 in overtime

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers passed for 246 yards and three touchdowns and the Green Bay Packers routed the Seattle Seahawks 38-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pack is back: Aaron Rodgers, Green Bay rout Seahawks 38-10

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Matt Ryan passed for 237 yards and three touchdowns and the Atlanta Falcons forced five turnovers in a 42-14 victory over the spiraling Los Angeles Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan throws for 3 TDs, Falcons thrash faltering Rams 42-14

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: The streaking Tampa Bay Buccaneers bolstered their playoff hopes by building an early lead and holding off Drew Brees and the New Orleans Saints 16-11 for their fifth straight victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Surging Bucs hold off Saints 16-11 for 5th straight victory

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: With a no-huddle offense and no-fooling-around defense, the Giants snapped the Cowboys' 11-game winning streak with a 10-7 victory Sunday night, preventing Dallas from clinching the NFC East.

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady connected with Chris Hogan for a 79-yard touchdown pass in the fourth quarter to help the Patriots overcome a sloppy second half and claim a 30-23 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Brady TD pass helps Patriots hold off Ravens 30-23
